16:43.text: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed
. So ask the people of the message

16:44.text: with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message
that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.

16:45.text: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allāh will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?

16:46.text: Or that He would not seize them during their
activity, and they could not cause failure

16:47.text: Or that He would not seize them gradually
But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

16:48.text: Have they not considered what things Allāh has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allāh, while they

16:49.text: And to Allāh prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels

16:50.text: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

16:51.text: And Allāh has said, "Do not take for yourselves two
is but one God, so fear only Me."

16:52.text: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is
worship constantly. Then is it other than Allāh that you fear?

16:53.text: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.

16:54.text: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
